scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn talent_api.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.verify:scoring: cd apps/api && uv run python -m talent_api.verify_scoring
scripts.test:db: cd apps/api && RUN_DB_TESTS=1 uv run pytest tests/test_database.py tests/test_import_pack.py tests/test_worker.py tests/test_candidate_api.py tests/test_hr_api.py
scripts.data:import: cd apps/api && uv run python -m talent_api.import_pack
scripts.worker: cd apps/api && uv run python -m talent_api.worker run
scripts.jobs:status: cd apps/api && uv run python -m talent_api.worker status
scripts.jobs:retry: cd apps/api && uv run python -m talent_api.worker retry
scripts.candidate:invite: cd apps/api && uv run python -m talent_api.invite_candidate
scripts.format: npm run format:web && npm run format:api
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:web && npm run format:check:api
scripts.format:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format:check:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:api
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:web && npm run lint:fix:api
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.lint:fix:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check --fix .
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check:web
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:web && npm run test:api && npm run test:db && npm run build
